typeDefs.name: Message
typeDefs.description: Represents the message payload with a unique consumer ID.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier used by the consumer to acknowledge the message

typeDefs.name: StoreListenerConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Represents the message store listener configuration,

fields.name: pollingInterval
fields.description: The interval in seconds at which the listener polls for new messages

fields.name: maxRetries
fields.description:
The maximum number of retries for processing a message. 
If set to 0, the message will not be retried

fields.name: retryInterval
fields.description: The interval in seconds between retries for processing a message

fields.name: ackWithFailureAfterMaxRetries
fields.description:
If true, the message will be acknowledged with failure after the maximum number of retries is reached.
Else the message will be acknowledged with success.

fields.name: deadLetterStore
fields.description:
An optional message store to store messages that could not be processed after the maximum 
number of retries. On successful storage, the message will be acknowledged with success

Attaches a message store service to the listener. Only one service can be attached to this 
listener.

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Gracefully stops the message store listener by waiting for any ongoing processing to 
complete before stopping. This is not implemented yet, and currently this will call 
immediateStop.

return.description: An error if the listener could not be stopped, or a nil value

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Immediately stops the message store listener without waiting for any ongoing processing 
to complete.

return.description: An error if the listener could not be stopped, or `()`.
